notes:
The piston-number warning can be switched off.

**Settings → Reader → "Warn when a piston number you type is already used."** It is on by default. Switch it off if you reuse piston numbers on purpose and the prompt just gets in the way.

It covers both warnings: a number already used in this piece, and a number already used on the same organ in another piece. Placing pistons the normal way was never affected — that stays quiet either way.

The setting belongs to each tablet separately, since the prompt only ever appears on the one you are editing on.
